The Project Manager will operate within a multidisciplinary design consultancy environment, responsible for the successful delivery of complex Data Centre projects across the region. The successful candidate will manage projects through all phases of delivery, ensuring objectives are achieved safely, efficiently, and in accordance with client requirements, quality standards, and business objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of project management experience within a design practice

Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
